description_html:
<section aria-labelledby="courseDescription">
    This course is an in-depth study of the mathematics curriculum currently taught in middle and secondary schools with an emphasis on content knowledge for teaching. The course consists of classroom instruction and may include a field component.  

Note: A grade of "C" or better must be earned in the course used to satisfy the general education mathematics requirement.
    
</section>
